title: Japanese-Style Cabbage Pilaf
description: A simple and healthy Japanese-inspired pilaf dish made with cabbage, rice, and a hint of sesame oil.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of sesame oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Add the shredded cabbage and cook until slightly softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the Japanese short-grain rice and stir to combine with the cabbage.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the water is absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and season with soy sauce to taste.
